description: Search EPA civil and criminal enforcement cases by state, regulatory program, or date range. Returns case identifier, regulated facility name and Registry ID, programs involved, penalty assessed, settlement date, and case type. Designed for area-level violation discovery — for a single known facility's enforcement history use epa_get_facility instead. At least one of state or zip_code is required.

case_type.description: Filter by case type: civil (regulatory violations), criminal (willful violations), or all

date_filed_end.description: End date for case filing date range (ISO 8601: YYYY-MM-DD)

date_filed_start.description: Start date for case filing date range (ISO 8601: YYYY-MM-DD)

limit.description: Maximum number of cases to return (1–100)

program.description: Filter by regulatory program: CAA=Clean Air Act, CWA=Clean Water Act, RCRA=hazardous waste, SDWA=drinking water, CERCLA=Superfund, FIFRA=pesticides, TSCA=toxic substances

state.description: 2-letter US state abbreviation to filter cases (e.g. "TX", "CA")

zip_code.description: 5-digit ZIP code to filter cases near that area

name: epa_search_violations

items.description: EPA enforcement case record with case number, program, and penalty details

caseId.description: Case number / docket identifier (e.g. "03-2014-7010") — primary case reference

facilityName.description: Regulated facility name — not available in ECHO enforcement case records; use epa_get_facility with a Registry ID for facility details

filedDate.description: Date the enforcement case was filed

penaltyAssessedInDollars.description: Federal penalty assessed in dollars (parsed from ECHO dollar string)

registryId.description: EPA Registry ID — not returned in enforcement case search results; obtain via epa_search_facilities

state.description: State where the facility is located — not returned in enforcement case search results

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_geographic_filter`: Neither state nor zip_code was provided. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.
Recovery hint when no cases are found — echoes filters and suggests broadening. Absent when cases are returned.

totalCount.description: Total cases matched before the limit was applied

title: Search EPA Enforcement Cases
